integrity: All numerical assertions are backed by two executable finite enumerations and complete orbit-size data. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact equation-weighted finite enumeration over F2 only. Nart--Ritzenthaler already supplies a complete isomorphism classification and geometric bitangent descent framework; the numerical distribution can potentially be derived from that published classification by additional weighted counting. Publication priority of the explicit histogram cannot be guaranteed. No assertion of novelty for the possible geometric bitangent counts or seven-bitangent example.
title: Rational-bitangent frequency distribution for smooth plane quartics over \(\mathbf F_2\)
